_comments.exclude: Repos never imported. 'skills' is always excluded — it IS this registry. Add repo names here to opt a repo out of bulk import.
_comments.include_only: If set, only these repos are scanned during bulk import (overrides exclude). Useful for CI testing.
_comments.source_dirs: Overrides the default set of directories the importer checks for skill subdirectories. Default: ['skills', '.agent/skills', '.agents/skills', '.claude/skills'].
_comments.sources: Explicit repo+path imports, including private repos. Bulk org listing never discovers private repos. Each entry is {"repo": "<name>", "path": "<subpath>"}. path may be a skill directory, a SKILL.md file, or a container such as skills/. Files are copied into this public registry — sources[] is the consent gate. GitHub Actions needs SKILLS_IMPORT_TOKEN (contents:read on those repos) to read private paths; public sync works with GITHUB_TOKEN alone.
